app.name: Mannon
app.tagline: Wholesale quoting, without the email grind

install.body: Mannon runs your wholesale prices, registration forms, order limits and net terms inside Shopify — and gives your buyers an agent that answers “what's my price at 100 units?” without a support ticket.
install.hint: Enter the .myshopify.com domain, not your custom domain.

home.description: Your wholesale command center — KPIs, the Merchant Agent briefing, and what needs you today.

pricing.description: Every price rule in one place: volume tiers, custom prices, discounts, priority and combinations.

customers.description: Approve wholesale applications, manage groups and tiers, and keep tags in sync.

forms.description: Build and publish the registration form buyers fill in to apply for wholesale.

orders.description: Wholesale orders, order limits, net payment terms, quotes and draft orders.

storefrontAgent.description: Configure the Buyer Agent your wholesale customers chat with, and review every conversation.

analytics.description: Wholesale revenue, rule performance, the registration funnel and net-terms aging.

settings.description: Price display, discount combinations, notifications, translations, agent controls and the audit log.

plans.description: Your plan, what it includes, and an honest recommendation based on how you actually use Mannon.

advisorSoon.body: Once Mannon has a month of your usage, Claude will tell you whether your plan still fits — including when the honest answer is to stay where you are.

planTagline.growth: Unlimited rules and forms, CSV import, auto-tagging and order limits.
planTagline.pro: Net terms, shipping rules, draft orders, POS, Markets — and the Merchant Agent.
planTagline.agentic: The storefront Buyer Agent, PO-to-order, quote drafting and ERP sync.

limits.heading: Order limits
limits.emptyBody: A limit sets the smallest — or largest — order a wholesale buyer can place. For example, a {{example}} minimum for your Silver tier.
limits.emptyExampleMinimum: A {{example}} minimum per order, so small orders go through your retail store instead.
limits.emptyExampleCase: Cases of 12, so buyers can't order 7 of something you ship by the dozen.
limits.emptyExampleMaximum: A maximum order value, so an unusually large order comes to you as a quote first.
limits.groupHelp: A group's limit replaces the store-wide one for its members — they don't stack.
limits.incrementHelp: The cart's total must be a multiple of this. Leave empty if you don't sell by the case.
limits.countriesHelp: Two-letter codes, separated by commas — SA, AE. Leave empty to apply everywhere.
limits.notPublished: These limits haven't reached Shopify yet, so nothing is being held to them. Save a limit to publish them.
limits.posLabel: Orders taken in person ignore these limits
limits.posHelp: On by default: a minimum written for a website isn't usually a rule about a till.
limits.previewBody: Written by the same code that runs at checkout, so this is the wording and the number your buyer gets.
limits.lockedHeading: Order limits are on a paid plan
limits.lockedBody: Limits you've already set keep working — nothing is deleted. Upgrade to {{plan}} to change them.
limits.issuesHeading: This limit can't be saved yet

summary.none: No bounds set — this limit does nothing

issue.no_bounds: Set at least one minimum, maximum or case size. A limit with nothing in it stops nobody.
issue.min_above_max_subtotal: The minimum order value is above the maximum. No cart could satisfy both.
issue.min_above_max_quantity: The minimum number of items is above the maximum. No cart could satisfy both.
issue.negative: Amounts and quantities can't be negative.
issue.increment_too_small: A case size of 1 doesn't restrict anything. Leave it empty instead.
issue.increment_conflicts_with_minimum: The minimum isn't a whole number of cases — the next one up is {{detail}}.
issue.increment_conflicts_with_maximum: The maximum is below one full case, so no cart could ever qualify.

terms.notPublishedBody: Until they reach Shopify, checkout falls back to its defaults — which can mean your pay-later method is shown to everybody. Save the settings below to publish them.

ledger.allPaidBody: Every invoice on terms has been paid. New ones appear here as buyers on terms check out.

settings.heading: Paying later at checkout
settings.intro: Shopify has no built-in net terms, so set up a manual payment method in your checkout settings and name it here. Mannon hides it from everyone whose terms do not allow it — they see nothing at all, not a disabled button.
settings.methodHelp: The name exactly as it appears in Settings → Payments → Manual payment methods.
settings.methodRequired: Name the payment method. An empty name would match every method and hide the whole payment step.
settings.showDaysLabel: Rename it at checkout to say the buyer's terms
settings.showDaysHelp: An eligible buyer sees “Pay later (Net 30)” rather than having to guess what applies to them.
settings.overdueBlocksLabel: An overdue invoice stops further credit
settings.overdueBlocksHelp: A buyer with anything past its due date has to pay now, until they settle it.

quotes.lockedHeading: Quotes are on a paid plan
quotes.lockedBody: Quotes you have already sent still stand and their links still work — nothing is deleted. Upgrade to {{plan}} to send more.

list.heading: Quotes
list.emptyBody: Build a quote for a buyer who asked for a price, or wait for one to arrive from your storefront. Prices are fixed the moment you draft it, so a buyer who accepts next week pays this week's price.
list.noResultsBody: Try a different status, or clear the filters to see everything.
list.searchLabel: Search by quote number, buyer or email

detail.noLinesBody: Search your catalogue above and add what the buyer asked for. Prices come from your wholesale rules.
detail.lockedAt: Prices fixed on {{at}}. They do not change unless you re-price this quote.
detail.driftHeading: Your rules have changed since this was priced
detail.driftBody: The prices below are the ones this buyer was quoted and the ones they will be charged. Where the store would now charge something different, the line says so. Re-price the quote if you would rather offer today's price.
detail.suggestionBody: Claude drafts a reply and checks it against your margin floor.
detail.suggestionUnavailable: Claude will draft a reply here and check it against your margin floor. That arrives with the rest of the AI features.
detail.messageHelp: Goes in the email and appears above the prices on their page.
detail.internalNoteHelp: Staff only. The buyer never sees this.
detail.sentLocked: This quote is with the buyer, so its prices cannot be changed. Withdraw it if you need to offer something different.
detail.linkBody: The same link that went in their email. Anyone with it can accept the quote, so share it only with them.
detail.acceptedBody: This quote became a draft order in Shopify, at the prices quoted. Invoice or complete it there.

public.heading: Quote {{number}}
public.acceptedThanks: Thank you — we have passed this to the seller, who will be in touch to complete your order.
public.declinedThanks: Thank you for letting us know.
public.closedAccepted: You have already accepted this quote. The seller will be in touch to complete your order.
public.closedDeclined: This quote was declined. Get in touch with the seller if that was a mistake.
public.closedExpired: This quote has run out. Get in touch with the seller if you would still like it.
public.closedNotSent: This quote is not ready yet. The seller will send it to you when it is.

describe.heading: ✦ Describe a rule
describe.composerHeading: Say what you want in one sentence
describe.sentenceHelp: Claude drafts it. Nothing changes until you approve the draft.
describe.example1: Buy 10 get 5%, buy 50 get 12%, only for customers tagged wholesale, exclude sale items.
describe.example2: Gold group pays 30% off everything, from the first of next month.
describe.example3: Free-shipping tier: 10% off any order over 2,000.
describe.offBody: This store has no Anthropic API key, so Claude cannot draft rules here. Everything else works — build the rule yourself and it will price exactly the same.
describe.atLimitHeading: Your plan's rule limit is used up
describe.atLimitBody: You can still draft a rule, but approving it needs a free slot. Archive a rule you no longer use, or move to a bigger plan.
describe.draftIntro: ✦ Drafted by Claude · review it before it goes live. You approve it, not the AI.
describe.combinable: May combine with your other Mannon rules.
describe.notCombinable: Does not combine with your other Mannon rules.
describe.clarifyBody: Claude named something it could not match to this store. Pick what you meant — approving is off until you do.
describe.noSuchThing: Nothing in this store is called “{{term}}”. Open the builder to pick it yourself.
describe.approveAnywayLabel: I know this sells below cost, and I want it anyway
describe.approveAnywayHelp: Some merchants price a line at a loss on purpose. Mannon will not stop you — it just will not do it quietly.
describe.confirmMissingHeading: Tick the box to approve this one
describe.confirmMissingBody: This rule sells at least one product below what it costs you. Approving it needs the confirmation above.

no_key.heading: Drafting is switched off
no_key.body: This store has no Anthropic API key. Build the rule yourself — it will price exactly the same.

refused.heading: Claude did not draft that one
refused.body: Try describing the rule differently, or build it yourself.

invalid_output.heading: That draft could not be read
invalid_output.body: Claude's answer did not make a valid rule, twice. Try a simpler sentence, or build it yourself.

error.heading: Drafting failed

empty.heading: Say what the rule should do

margin.clearBody_one: Checked {{count}} product against your recorded costs.
margin.clearBody_other: Checked {{count}} products against your recorded costs.

segments.noSuchGroup: There is no group called “{{term}}”. Remove that filter, or create the group first.

last_order_days.gte_other: No order for {{count}} days or more

briefing.confirmMuteBody: The agent will not raise it again until you turn it back on below. Nothing else changes.

po.buyerHelp: Their contract prices are what gets used.
po.textHelp: Paste the email or the lines. Claude reads what was ordered; Mannon prices it.

agent.heading: Buyer Agent
agent.description: A chat concierge on your storefront that answers your approved buyers at their own prices. It reads your published rules; it never invents a price.

locked.heading: The Buyer Agent needs a different plan
locked.body: Your guardrails are kept exactly as they are. Move to {{plan}} to publish the agent and answer buyers again.

publish.heading: Publishing
publish.body: Four things have to be true before the agent talks to your buyers.
publish.notReady: Finish the list above and this button turns on.

step.rule: At least one active pricing rule

publish.refusedBody: Still outstanding: {{steps}}. Nothing has changed on your storefront.
publish.liveBody: Approved buyers who are signed in can chat with it on your storefront.
publish.noDomain: We don't know your storefront address yet. It will appear here after your next sync.
publish.embedUnknown: Published here — but we haven't seen your storefront call us yet.
publish.embedHow: The Mannon app embed also has to be switched on in your theme editor, under App embeds. If you've just turned it on, this will update the first time a buyer loads a page.
publish.embedAttested: You've told us the app embed is on. We'll confirm it the first time a buyer loads a page.

abilities.heading: What the agent may do
abilities.body: Each of these is checked in our own code before the work happens, not asked of the model. Switching one off removes the ability, not a sentence in a prompt.
abilities.note: A change here applies to the next conversation. A chat already in progress finishes under the rules it started with.
abilities.canBuildCartHelp: Assemble a cart at the buyer's prices for them to review. Checkout is always Shopify's.
abilities.canRequestQuoteHelp: File a quote request for you to price. The agent never sets a price itself.
abilities.canReadOrdersHelp: Tell a buyer where their own recent orders are. Never anybody else's.
abilities.canReadTermsHelp: State the buyer's net terms, credit limit and what they owe.

guestMode.label: Answer signed-out visitors
guestMode.help: Off by default. This is a wholesale concierge: a signed-out visitor gets retail answers at best, and a support ticket at worst.

tone.heading: Tone
tone.label: How the agent writes
tone.brief: Brief — as few words as the answer needs

instructions.heading: Your own instructions
instructions.label: Anything else the agent should know
instructions.help: Up to {{max}} words. Advisory: instructions can shape how the agent writes, never what it is allowed to do.
instructions.tooLong: That's over {{max}} words. Shorten it and save again.
instructions.warningsHeading: Some of this asks for something the agent won't do

offLimits.heading: Off-limits subjects
offLimits.label: Subjects to decline, one per line
offLimits.help: A message that mentions one of these is declined in our words, before the agent reads it. Whole words: “competitors” does not catch “competitive”.

review.heading: Review
review.help: Read what's above, then say you've read it. This is the one item on the publish list we can't check for you.

failure.no_key: Claude isn't connected, so the agent can't answer. Add an Anthropic API key and try again.
failure.timeout: Claude took too long to answer. Try again.
failure.rate_limited: Claude is rate-limited right now. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.refused: Claude declined to answer that one.
failure.invalid_output: Claude's answer didn't come back in a shape we could use, so nothing was sent.
failure.error: Something went wrong reaching Claude. Nothing was sent.
failure.not_published: The agent isn't published, so it doesn't answer buyers yet.
failure.guest: That visitor isn't an approved buyer, and guest answers are off.
failure.taken_over: You're in this conversation, so the agent has stopped answering.
failure.empty: There was no message to answer.
failure.invented_figure: The reply stated a figure this app hadn't computed, so it was thrown away rather than sent.

log.emptyBody: No conversations yet — publish the agent to start.

log.noResultsBody: Nothing here matches what you searched for.

analytics.missingLines_other: {{count}} orders have more lines than Shopify returned to us, so this chart is missing some of them.

revenue.heading: Wholesale and retail revenue
revenue.alt: Daily revenue, wholesale against retail, over the selected window.

byGroup.heading: Wholesale revenue by group

rules.note: A rule is matched by the name the buyer saw at checkout, so renaming one does not rewrite what it earned before. Rows marked “renamed or removed” no longer match a rule you have today.

funnel.heading: Registration funnel
funnel.alt: Applications submitted, approved, and followed by a first wholesale order.

footer.timezone: Days are your store's days, in {{zone}}.

review.heading: ✦ Monthly review
review.body: Written on the first of each month, about the month just gone, and kept. Nothing here changes once it is written — so you can read this month against last.
review.lockedPlan: The monthly review comes with the Merchant Agent, on {{plan}}.
review.lockedNoKey: There's no Anthropic API key set, so no review can be written. Every figure it would have used is on the charts page.
review.emptyBody: Reviews are written on the first of the month. There isn't one yet.
review.emptyScheduled: The first one will be written on the first of next month, about this one.
review.firstMonth: This is your first review, so there's no month before it to compare against.
review.quiet: Nothing happened last month that needs you. That's a real answer, not a missing one.
